shortDescription: Manage devices in the Meraki cloud

options.name: address
options.description: Postal address of device's location.

options.name: auth_key
options.description: Authentication key provided by the dashboard. Required if environmental variable C(MERAKI_KEY) is not set.

options.name: host
options.description: Hostname for Meraki dashboard. Can be used to access regional Meraki environments, such as China.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname of network device to search for.

options.name: internal_error_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if server returns an internal server error.

options.name: lat
options.description: Latitude of device's geographic location. Use negative number for southern hemisphere.

options.name: lldp_cdp_timespan
options.description: Timespan, in seconds, used to query LLDP and CDP information. Must be less than 1 month.

options.name: lng
options.description: Longitude of device's geographic location. Use negative number for western hemisphere.

options.name: model
options.description: Model of network device to search for.

options.name: move_map_marker
options.description: Whether or not to set the latitude and longitude of a device based on the new address. Only applies when C(lat) and C(lng) are not specified.

options.name: net_id
options.description: ID of a network.

options.name: net_name
options.description: Name of a network.

options.name: note
options.description: Informational notes about a device. Limited to 255 characters.

options.name: org_id
options.description: ID of organization.

options.name: org_name
options.description: Name of organization.

options.name: output_format
options.description: Instructs module whether response keys should be snake case (ex. C(net_id)) or camel case (ex. C(netId)).

options.name: output_level
options.description: Set amount of debug output during module execution.

options.name: query
options.description: Specifies what information should be queried.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if rate limiter is triggered.

options.name: serial
options.description: Serial number of a device to query.

options.name: state
options.description: Query an organization.

options.name: tags
options.description: Space delimited list of tags to assign to device.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to timeout for HTTP requests.

options.name: use_https
options.description: If C(no), it will use HTTP. Otherwise it will use HTTPS. Only useful for internal Meraki developers.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate HTTP certificates.
